params.rate_desc: Flat 4.55% rate (SB 69) less the taxpayer tax credit: 6% of that tax year's federal standard deduction, reduced by 1.3% of income over the 2024 phase-out of $17,652 ($35,304 joint), used as an estimate for earlier years. The credit base is the federal standard deduction, or federal itemized deductions when itemized_deductions is passed (pass them excluding state income tax, which Utah adds back; that add-back is not computed). The per-dependent exemption is added to that base when dependents is passed ($565 for 2018, $579 for 2019, $590 for 2020, $1,750 for 2021, $1,802 for 2022, $1,941 for 2023, $2,046 for 2024, $2,111 for 2025; later years raise when dependents > 0 until sourced).
